title: PvpTracker
description: Lightweight client-side PvP mod that shows a small damage overlay during player fights. Disappears instantly on death.
body:
# PvP Tracker

A lightweight client-side Fabric mod for PvP combat damage tracking.

When you hit a player or a player hits you, a small overlay appears in the top-left corner showing:

- Your name and total damage dealt
- Opponent name and total damage taken

The overlay disappears instantly when either player dies. No summary, no timers, no extra UI — just raw damage numbers during the fight.

## Features
- Automatic combat detection
- Live damage updates every tick
- Instant overlay on combat start
- Instant clear on death
- Zero performance impact
- No config, no keybinds, no clutter

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.16+
- Fabric API
- Minecraft 1.21 / 1.21.1
